old: The lookup speed is purchased with initialization work and storage. The allocated Uint8Array has (15+1)×32,768 entries, or 524,288 payload bytes, including unused slots for shorter masks. If the maximum supported length L were allowed to grow, enumerating every mask would be exponential in L. The direct classification routines can perform nested empty-cell trials and five scans, giving a coarse O(L³) bound per mask and O(2^L L³) preprocessing overall. Once initialized, lookup is constant time for a supported segment, but constructing its mask still scans its cells. Incremental counts therefore reduce which lines are recomputed; they do not make an arbitrary whole-board evaluation O(1). A source-level extension beyond length 15 must also revise the fixed shift/index layout rather than relying on the larger coordinate capacity of BotBoard.

For illustration, a uniform tree of width 8 and depth 5 has 8^5 = 32,768 leaves and 37,449 total nodes before pruning. This is a fixed-width model, not an upper bound for the implemented soft-cap search. The tier timings and actual counters are reported in Chapter 5; configuration alone does not establish a latency bound or a measured progression in playing strength.
